Row.Text: City must be built next to a mountain
[NEWLINE]"All difficult things have their origin in that which is easy, and great things in that which is small."[NEWLINE] - Lao Tzu[NEWLINE]

Xuankong Si, also known as the Hanging Temple, is a temple carved into and built on a cliff face 1275 metres above sea level. According to legend construction began around 1600 years ago by a single monk known as Liao Ran. Xuankong Si is unique largely due to the fact that instead of a single religious focus the temple has elements of Taoism, Buddhism and Confucianism.
